XML Formatter

Pretty-print or minify XML with a real tokenizer that handles comments, CDATA, and self-closing tags.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your XML into the input box.
  2. Choose Pretty-print or Minify and pick an indent style.
  3. Click Format — the result appears below, ready to copy or download.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What XML features are supported?

Elements, attributes, comments, CDATA sections, processing instructions, DOCTYPE declarations, and self-closing tags are all handled.

What happens with invalid XML?

You get a precise error message, e.g. a mismatched closing tag or an unclosed element, instead of silent garbage output.

Does minify remove comments?

Only if you tick the remove-comments option. CDATA content is always preserved either way.

Is my XML sent anywhere?

No. Everything runs in your browser; nothing leaves your device.
